final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), sex_groups AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_groups GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS overall_avg_alb FROM sex_groups) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.overall_avg_alb AS difference FROM sex_groups AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_alb > o.overall_avg_alb
